title: Activity feed component for grouped events
description: A data-driven React activity feed that groups consecutive actor, verb, and object events into compact, themeable summaries.

og.title: Activity Feed · Zentauri UI
og.description: Grouped actor, verb, and object events for application activity feeds.

twitter.title: Activity Feed · Zentauri UI
twitter.description: A compact data-driven activity feed with automatic grouping.

intro: ActivityFeed accepts structured actor, verb, and object events, then groups adjacent matching actions without requiring consumers to compose timeline items manually.

faqs.question: What events are grouped?
faqs.answer: By default, adjacent events are grouped when their actor id, verb, and object id match. The original display order is preserved.

faqs.question: Can I show every event?
faqs.answer: Yes. Set grouping to none to render every supplied event as an individual feed row.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Use ActivityFeed for structured activity data. Each event contains an actor, verb, object, and optional timestamp; groups display their event count and latest timestamp.
